parole.testo: Ultimately a reborrowing from Ancient Greek ἀφύη (aphúē, “small fish”). The immediate source is Venetan anciuga, from Ligurian anciôa, from a Vulgar Latin development of Classical Latin aphyē, from Ancient Greek ἀφύη (aphúē).
